title: Monkey D. Luffy
content: Monkey D. Luffy is the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and was born in Foosha Village[cite: 309, 310]. He is the son of the revolutionary Monkey D. Dragon and the grandson of Marine hero Monkey D. Garp[cite: 310]. At age seven, he ate the Gomu Gomu no Mi, later revealed to be the Mythical Zoan Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika, which grants him the properties of rubber and is tied to the legendary 'Warrior of Liberation'[cite: 311, 312]. He was inspired to become a pirate by 'Red-Haired' Shanks, who entrusted him with his signature straw hat[cite: 313].

title: Roronoa Zoro
content: Roronoa Zoro is the combatant of the Straw Hat Pirates and a former bounty hunter who trained at the Shimotsuki Dojo[cite: 314, 315]. He carries a lifelong promise to his deceased childhood rival, Kuina, to become the world's greatest swordsman[cite: 316]. He is a master of the 'Three-Sword Style' and recently awakened Conqueror's Haki during the battle against the Beasts Pirates[cite: 317].

title: Nami
content: Nami is the navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates and is highly knowledgeable about global geography and the Kaienreki (Sea Circle Calendar)[cite: 318, 321]. An orphan found in the Oykoy Kingdom and adopted by the former Marine Belle-mere, she spent her childhood as a thief for the Arlong Pirates to buy back her village's freedom[cite: 319, 320].

title: Usopp
content: Usopp is the sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates, born in Syrup Village to Yasopp and Banchina[cite: 322, 323]. He is known for tall tales that often manifest as truth over time, and he dreams of becoming a 'brave warrior of the sea' like the giants of Elbaf[cite: 324, 325].

title: Sanji
content: Sanji is the cook of the Straw Hat Pirates who seeks the All Blue[cite: 326, 329]. Born a prince of the Vinsmoke family, he was deemed a failure for possessing human emotions, eventually escaping to be mentored by 'Red-Leg' Zeff[cite: 327, 328].

title: Tony Tony Chopper
content: Tony Tony Chopper is the doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates and a reindeer who ate the Hito Hito no Mi (Human-Human Fruit)[cite: 330, 331]. After being ostracized, he was raised by Dr. Hiriluk and Dr. Kureha, and he now seeks to become a doctor capable of curing any disease[cite: 332, 333].

title: Nico Robin
content: Nico Robin is the archaeologist of the Straw Hat Pirates and the sole survivor of the Buster Call on Ohara[cite: 334, 335]. Known as the 'Devil Child,' she is currently the only person known to be able to read Poneglyphs, indestructible stones that reveal the world's true history[cite: 336, 337].

title: Franky
content: Franky is the shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates and a former apprentice to the legendary Tom[cite: 338, 339]. After a tragic accident involving the World Government, he rebuilt his body with scrap metal as a cyborg and later built the Thousand Sunny using Treasure Wood Adam[cite: 340, 341].

title: Brook
content: Brook is the musician of the Straw Hat Pirates, a former Rumbar Pirate resurrected as a skeleton by the Yomi Yomi no Mi[cite: 342, 343]. He spent 50 years in isolation in the Florian Triangle while keeping his promise to return to the island whale Laboon[cite: 344, 345].

title: Jinbe
content: Jinbe is the helmsman of the Straw Hat Pirates, a former Warlord, and former captain of the Sun Pirates[cite: 346, 347]. A master of Fishman Karate and advocate for peace, he famously fought Portgas D. Ace for five days before they became allies[cite: 348, 349].

title: Joy Boy
content: Joy Boy was a legendary figure from the Void Century who possessed the Nika fruit[cite: 350]. He left a treasure on the final island, Laugh Tale, and made a promise to the people of Fishman Island involving the massive ark Noah[cite: 351, 352].

title: Gol D. Roger
content: Gol D. Roger was the Pirate King and the first person in 800 years to reach Laugh Tale and discover Joy Boy's treasure[cite: 353, 354]. His execution 24 years ago sparked the Great Pirate Era when he challenged the world to find his fortune[cite: 355].

title: Imu
content: Imu is the secret 'King of the World' who leads the Five Elders from the Empty Throne in Mary Geoise[cite: 356, 357]. A survivor from the Void Century, Imu seeks to extinguish the 'D. Clan' and any lights that threaten the World Government's control[cite: 357, 358].

title: Dr. Vegapunk
content: Dr. Vegapunk is the world's greatest genius whose technology is 500 years ahead of the current era[cite: 359]. He recently broadcasted a message revealing that the planet is sinking due to the use of Ancient Weapons during the Void Century[cite: 360, 361].

title: Whitebeard (Edward Newgate)
content: Whitebeard was the founder of the Whitebeard Pirates and a former member of the Rocks Pirates[cite: 362]. He sought a 'family' over wealth, becoming a father figure to thousands and taking in Portgas D. Ace as his 'son' after dueling Jinbe for five days[cite: 363, 364].

title: Kaido
content: Kaido was a former Emperor and member of the Rocks Pirates who established a brutal rule over Wano Country[cite: 365, 366]. Known as a powerful soldier since childhood, he took in orphans like Ulti and Page One into his Beasts Pirates[cite: 365, 366].

title: Big Mom (Charlotte Linlin)
content: Charlotte Linlin was an Emperor who established Totto Land, a nation where all races supposedly live in harmony through her extortion of souls[cite: 367, 368]. Abandoned on Elbaf as a child, she has a vast family of 85 children, including commanders like Katakuri, Smoothie, and Cracker[cite: 367, 369].

title: Blackbeard (Marshall D. Teach)
content: Marshall D. Teach is the only known person to wield two Devil Fruits and is a former member of Whitebeard's crew[cite: 370, 371]. He orchestrated the Rocky Port Incident to seize control of Hachinosu and recently kidnapped Captain Koby[cite: 372].

title: Shanks
content: Shanks is the captain of the Red-Haired Pirates and a former apprentice of Gol D. Roger[cite: 373]. Found as a baby in a treasure chest at God Valley, he later became an Emperor and recently decimated the Kid Pirates at Elbaf[cite: 374, 375, 376].

title: Kouzuki Oden
content: Kouzuki Oden was the heir of Wano and the only samurai to reach Laugh Tale, having sailed with both Whitebeard and Roger[cite: 377, 378]. He sacrificed his dignity for five years to protect his citizens from Kaido before his execution[cite: 379].

title: Bartholomew Kuma
content: Bartholomew Kuma was a founding member of the Revolutionary Army and King of the Sorbet Kingdom who was born to the Buccaneer race[cite: 380, 381]. He sacrificed his humanity to become a cyborg Pacifista to save his daughter, Bonney[cite: 382].

title: Rocks D. Xebec
content: Rocks D. Xebec was a legendary pirate who led future Emperors Whitebeard, Kaido, and Big Mom from Hachinosu[cite: 383, 384]. He aimed to be 'King of the World' but was defeated and erased from history after the God Valley Incident[cite: 385].

title: Mont Blanc Noland & Kalgara
content: Mont Blanc Noland was an explorer who saved the Shandia from 'Tree Fever' and befriended their warrior Kalgara[cite: 386]. After the City of Gold vanished into the sky, Noland was executed as a 'liar' for his claims[cite: 387].

title: Shimotsuki Ryuma
content: Shimotsuki Ryuma, known as the 'Blade God,' was a legendary samurai from Wano who slayed a dragon[cite: 388]. His prowess was so great it deterred the World Government and pirates from invading Wano for generations[cite: 389].

title: Monkey D. Dragon
content: Monkey D. Dragon is the leader of the Revolutionary Army and the father of Monkey D. Luffy[cite: 390]. Originally a Marine, he formed the 'Freedom Fighters' 25 years ago to oppose the World Government's corruption[cite: 391].

title: Donquixote Doflamingo
content: Donquixote Doflamingo is the former King of Dress Rosa and a former Celestial Dragon whose family was persecuted after his father renounced their status[cite: 392, 393]. He killed his father and turned to piracy, eventually seizing his throne[cite: 393].

title: Boa Hancock
content: Boa Hancock is the 'Snake Princess' of Amazon Lily and a former slave of the Celestial Dragons[cite: 394]. She became a Warlord to protect her island and recently survived an invasion by the Marines and Blackbeard[cite: 395, 396].

title: Sentomaru
content: Sentomaru is Dr. Vegapunk's personal bodyguard, recruited after living in the wild as an abandoned child[cite: 397]. He was trained in Haki and mentored by Admiral Kizaru[cite: 398].

title: Portgas D. Ace
content: Portgas D. Ace was the 2nd Division Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates and the biological son of Gol D. Roger[cite: 399, 400]. The sworn brother of Luffy and Sabo, he was raised on Dawn Island by Curly Dadan under Garp's supervision[cite: 401, 402].

title: Sabo
content: Sabo is the Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, known as the 'Flame Emperor' and the sworn brother of Ace and Luffy[cite: 403, 405]. Born a noble in the Goa Kingdom, he was rescued by Monkey D. Dragon and later ate the Mera Mera no Mi[cite: 404, 406, 407].

title: Yamato
content: Yamato is the child of Kaido who identifies as Kouzuki Oden and follows Oden's journal[cite: 408, 409]. Imprisoned for years on Onigashima, Yamato befriended Ace and later fought alongside Luffy to liberate Wano[cite: 410, 411].

title: Jewelry Bonney
content: Jewelry Bonney is the captain of the Bonney Pirates, raised by Kuma after being born to Ginny and a Celestial Dragon[cite: 412, 413]. Cured of Sapphire Scale through Kuma's deal with the Government, she uses the Toshi Toshi no Mi to manipulate age[cite: 414, 415].

title: Nefertari Vivi
content: Nefertari Vivi is the princess of Alabasta and a direct descendant of Nefertari D. Lily[cite: 416, 418]. A secret member of the 'D. Clan,' she served as a temporary Straw Hat during the struggle against Baroque Works[cite: 419, 420].

title: Kouzuki Momonosuke
content: Kouzuki Momonosuke is the Shogun of Wano who can command the elephant Zunesha[cite: 421, 423]. Sent 20 years into the future by his mother, he ate a man-made dragon fruit created by Vegapunk[cite: 424, 425].

title: Trafalgar D. Water Law
content: Trafalgar D. Water Law is the captain of the Heart Pirates and a member of the 'D. Clan' mentored by Corazon[cite: 426, 428, 429]. A survivor of Flevance, he allied with the Straw Hats to take down Emperors Doflamingo, Kaido, and Big Mom[cite: 427, 430].

title: Silvers Rayleigh
content: Silvers Rayleigh, known as the 'Dark King,' was the first mate of the Roger Pirates[cite: 431]. He served as Luffy's mentor during the timeskip, training him in Haki, and recently protected Boa Hancock from invasion[cite: 433, 434].

title: Dracule Mihawk
content: Dracule Mihawk is the 'World's Greatest Swordsman' and a founding member of the Cross Guild alongside Crocodile[cite: 435, 439]. He has a long-standing rivalry with Shanks and lived in isolation on Kuraigana Island[cite: 437, 438].

title: Crocodile
content: Crocodile is the former president of Baroque Works and the true mastermind behind the Cross Guild[cite: 440, 443]. He previously spent sixteen years in Alabasta as a 'hero' to hide his goal of seizing the Ancient Weapon Pluton[cite: 441].

title: Buggy the Clown
content: Buggy the Clown is a former apprentice of the Roger Pirates and the figurehead leader of the Cross Guild[cite: 444, 447]. Despite accidental successes leading to his status as an Emperor, he is secretly subservient to Crocodile and Mihawk[cite: 446, 447].

title: Koby
content: Koby is a Marine Captain in SWORD who was personally trained by Garp[cite: 448, 450]. A 'hero' of the Rocky Port Incident, he recently became Blackbeard's hostage to save 800 fellow Marines[cite: 451, 452].

title: Monkey D. Garp
content: Monkey D. Garp is the legendary 'Hero of the Marines' and the grandfather of Monkey D. Luffy[cite: 453, 454]. He famously teamed with Roger at God Valley to defeat Rocks and raised both Luffy and Ace in secret[cite: 455, 456].
